text:
Alex: Sunup ops pass — I'm oncall until 10:30am PT. Quick bullets: 1) EU canary restarts finished ~8:50, health checks green. 2) Prefetch backfill running, expect small latency blip on gen routes (~50-100ms) for next ~20m. 3) Rolling deploy for release/3.2.1 scheduled 09:00 — fallback to model-v2 on errors. 4) Small KV eviction delta in us-east; watch it. Action: @Priya please confirm autoscale config; @Sam can you take over at 10:30? :wave:

Jordan: Thanks Alex. noted the prefetch blip, I'll keep the tokens/cost dashboard open and watch p95 latencies :eyes:

Priya: Looking now — autoscale HPA targets: min=2 max=8, cpu threshold 65%, cooldown 60s. Will post `kubectl get hpa -n inference` snippet in 2m.

Sam: I can take the 10:30 cover. FYI I've been seeing KV eviction rate tick to ~3.2% over the last 30m in us-east, no errors yet but worth watching. cc @Casey

Casey: That aligns with the cache-ttl tweak we rolled yesterday morning. Evictions expected to stabilize by noon; I'll leave the revert window open until 12:00 and flip if >5% or if error rate creeps.

deploy-bot: deploy started for release/3.2.1 at 09:01 UTC. CI job: https://ci.redwood/release/3.2.1/12345 — rolling across regions, will post status updates.

Priya: HPA check output: ```NAME       REFERENCE                TARGETS   MINPODS MAXPODS REPLICAS AGE
inference  Deployment/inference-api  45%/65%        2       8        3   4h
``` Autoscale config matches expected; no change required from my side. Also setting eval gate for model fallback at 09:10 (so if deploy hits >1% error rate we'll auto-fallback to model-v2).

Jordan: Pinged @oncall-bot for schedule swap just now.

oncall-bot: Shift swap recorded — Sam will cover from 10:30 to 18:30 local. Thanks! :white_check_mark:

Sam: Got it. I'll create a short watch channel `#oncall-sunup` and post any anomalies there (kv evictions, deploy errors, latency spikes).

Alex: Action items summarized: 1) Sam — monitor KV eviction + deploy rollout, take over at 10:30. 2) Priya — confirm eval gate (set for 09:10) and post any changed config. 3) Jordan — keep cost/token dashboard and p95 lat open. 4) Casey — maintain revert window until 12:00 and escalate if evictions >5%. I'll keep the bridge open for 30m and check back at 09:25.

Casey: Adding a quick link to the rollback runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/runbooks/deploy-rollback — follow step 2b if fallback needed.

Priya: Note — model-v2 is quantized fallback; expect slight variance in outputs for a tiny subset of prompts. We already have eval set for parity checks at 09:10.

Jordan: one small ask — if you see any token-cost jump during canary please @channel and tag me, I'll mute noise but want the data for the cost sprint.

Alex: Thanks team. no immediate action from me other than handing to Sam at 10:30. Bridge stays open 09:00-09:30. :coffee:

Sam: Roger. will post first status at 10:35 and escalate if anything abnormal.

deploy-bot: Rolling status: eu-canary ✅, us-east ✅, ap-south in progress. Estimated completion 09:12 UTC.

Jordan: Great — thanks everyone.

Alex: Signing off the thread, handing to Sam at 10:30. Good luck. :thumbsup:
